stated_limitation: median pseudo-R2 0.086, typical for single-bin spike prediction

justification.dataset: DANDI 000044 Achilles CA1 linear-track session is the canonical place-cell dataset, exactly what an expert would choose.
justification.handling: Real remfile-streamed NWB with explicit cell-type filtering, run-bout extraction, speed thresholding, and correct occupancy normalization.
justification.analysis: Skaggs spatial information with a 500-shuffle circular time-shift null, per-direction rate maps, and a nemos Poisson GLM cross-check are all appropriate and correctly executed.
justification.correctness: Every headline number (86/120, median SI 0.53 vs 0.01, dir corr 0.22, GLM corr 0.99, pseudo-R2 0.086) reproduces exactly from the committed cache and is internally consistent.
justification.figures: Overview, six representative example cells, diagonal population tiling, and stats panels are all clearly labeled with units and sample sizes and show the phenomenon plainly.
justification.honesty: Claims are proportionate and nothing is misrepresented (inhibitory units correctly flagged as low-SI), but there is no explicit limitations section and only a light caveat, keeping a genuinely clean result at 3.
